proof_roadmap.step: Finite residue fields via finite-type points.

difficulty_reason: For f : X -> Y as in the Stein factorization lemma (universally closed, f_*O_X recovered through pi : X -> Y' over an affine Y) strengthened by f locally of finite type, the fibre pi^{-1}({y}) = {y_1, ..., y_n} is finite and each kappa(y_i)/kappa(y) is finite. The retained proof: no specializations inside pi^{-1}({y}) (integral ring maps, Algebra lemma integral-no-inclusion); f' surjective makes |X_y| -> pi^{-1}({y}) surjective; X_y is quasi-separated of finite type over a field so |X_y| is Noetherian (Morphisms of Spaces, finite-presentation-noetherian); the author marks the purely topological finiteness step '(omitted)'; then finite-type points x_i over each y_i (enough-finite-type-points) exhibit kappa(y_i) as a finite-type residue extension of kappa(y), hence finite (Morphisms, point-finite-type). Retained author proof at lines 8068-8088.
